fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects potential process patterns related to Cobalt Strike beacon activity
fields.name: Potential CobaltStrike Process Patterns
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="windows" and ((tgt.process.cmdline contains "cmd.exe /C whoami" and src.process.image.path contains "C:\\Temp\\") or ((src.process.image.path contains "\\runonce.exe" or src.process.image.path contains "\\dllhost.exe") and (tgt.process.cmdline contains "cmd.exe /c echo" and tgt.process.cmdline contains "> \\\\.\\pipe")) or ((src.process.cmdline contains "cmd.exe /C echo" and src.process.cmdline contains " > \\\\.\\pipe") and tgt.process.cmdline contains "conhost.exe 0xffffffff -ForceV1") or (src.process.cmdline contains "/C whoami" and tgt.process.cmdline contains "conhost.exe 0xffffffff -ForceV1")))
